package.description: A small, compact tool for opening, resizing and converting TGA files

en-US.description: A small, compact tool for opening, resizing and converting TGA files
en-US.longDescription: TGA Viewer is a small, compact tool for opening, resizing and converting TGA file format to others image formats as JPEG, GIF, Bitmap, TIFF and others. With a very simple user interface this software is easy for using for every type of computer users, beginners or advanced users.
en-US.name: TGA Viewer

zh-CN.description: 一款用于打开、调整大小和转换 TGA 文件的小巧紧凑工具
zh-CN.longDescription: TGA 查看器是一款小巧紧凑的工具，可用于打开、调整大小以及将 TGA 文件格式转换为其他图像格式，如 JPEG、GIF、位图、TIFF 等。该软件界面非常简单，易于各类计算机用户使用，无论是初学者还是高级用户都很方便。
